# encoding/json/v2 shipped in Go 1.27 without the `format` tag option
# (https://go.dev/issue/79071): a format-tagged field makes marshal and
# unmarshal of the whole struct fail at runtime. The generator must
# reject the annotation at generate time instead of emitting broken code.
! jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Event
stderr 'format'

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "created": {
      "type":       "string",
      "goType":     "time.Time",
      "goImports":  ["time"],
      "goJSONTags": ["format:RFC3339Nano"]
    }
  }
}
